build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run bundle:sidecars

bundle.shortDescription: CoinCync privacy wallet — desktop app with local node & mining.
bundle.longDescription: CoinCync Wallet is the official desktop client: wallet setup, private send/receive, optional local node, and mining integration. Installers bundle the node, wallet CLI, and miner so you do not need separate downloads.

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* https://explorer.coincync.network https://api.github.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://explorer.coincync.network; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'
